photos.desc: Pla nueng manao (Thai: ปลานึ่งมะนาว): Fish steamed with lime juice. The fish is pla nin (Thai: ปลานิล, Oreochromis niloticus) so this dish would in full be called pla nin nueng manao (Thai: ปลานิลนึ่ง
Deep-frying fish (here a pla nin ; Nile Tilapia, Oreochromis niloticus ) in Thailand.
Pla thot (Thai script: ปลาทอด): a simple deep-fried fish, often served with a spicy dipping sauce. The fish in this image is pla nin , a Nile Tilapia.
Pla thapthim (Thai: ปลาทับทิม; Oreochromis niloticus or Nile Tilapia, red hybrid)
